Sophie L.: Need quick presales sync for BorealisHealth commit. They sent traffic: steady 30 qps text, chat spikes to 800 qps for 10-15m windows. Asking for minimal reserved + autoscale guidance.
Ravi - Presales: Finance wants predictable run-rate. Security flagged no cross-AZ spot for PHI.
Noah Ops: Proposal: reserve 3x A100-equivalent (quantized) to cover steady-state text and low chat concurrency. Autoscale policy: add +1 GPU at 65% util sustained 3m, add +2 if >80% for 2m. Burst credits capped to 40% of reserved for 20m windows.
Tess (Solutions): Recommend KV prewarm for chat: preheat ~150 sessions before launch. Fallback plan: smaller quantized model for degraded quality with X-Model-Fallback header.
Sophie L.: Can we include a monthly invoice cap option? They need finance signoff.
Ravi - Presales: Yes — offer reserved baseline + optional overage cap. Will prepare two quote lines: (1) no cap, overage billed; (2) capped overage with surcharge.
Noah Ops: Preheat snippet (pseudo):

curl -X POST $ENDPOINT/chat -d '{"session":"preheat-<n>","prompt":"<warming>"}'

This fans KV across GPUs and reduces tail latency.
Sophie L.: Action items: Tess to draft quote variants (ETA 24h), Noah to write short runbook and autoscale JSON, Ravi to confirm cap preference with customer. Thanks :thumbsup:
